scopeLimits: CUA sends immediate key taps, not sustained physical holds; W taps produced no resolvable map displacement. Actual held WASD, Shift, normalized diagonals, bounds and focus retention are validated by the755-check controller fixture and6824 navigation checks instead.
G was delivered natively; Control–Command–F remains the existing menu binding and was not separately sent during this session.
Full-screen transition resize was checked; arbitrary manual window-edge resize was not repeated this release.
